## How to test

## Checklist

- [ ] PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `chore:` …)
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] Tests added or updated
- [ ] No `any` at public package boundaries
- [ ] If this touches query execution or credentials: read-only, timeout and row limits still enforced
